title: Not worth the $26 I paid to get it.
text: Not worth the $26 I paid to get it.. The ornament that arrives looks very much different than what is pictured on the website. It is a flat piece of plastic that you can tie a ribbon or a golden cord to. The picture on the website made it look like it was three dimensional. I'm very disappointed.
